scores.evidence: There are four can-do objectives with Bloom levels. Each one has an inline item and at least one exam item with objectiveId: o1 q1/q5, o2 q2/q6, o3 q3/q7, o4 q4/q8/q10/q9. The apply/transfer items are q5 (料理教室) and q7 (水やり記録).
hook-b1 sets a concrete scene in 3 sentences (「グラフや分類が並んだ画面がすぐにできました。でも、ほしかったのは「月の途中で食費の使いすぎに気づける」ことでした」). It has no trivia, and the ungraded predict q0 leads into o2.

Prerequisites list ch0 and ch1. s1-b1 recalls ch0 (ビジョン), and ex-data recalls ch1 (「第1章で学んだデータベース」). Terms are defined in definitions blocks before the quizzes. However, the q4 explanation names 「Claude Codeの公式ガイド」 although neither ch0 nor ch1 introduces Claude Code, and 「仕様書」 is used before it is glossed.

Each segment teaches one idea and introduces at most 2 new terms (壁打ち / 目的・機能 / MVP・MoSCoW / 1枚企画書・PRD). Lint shows 0 sentence or paragraph warnings, and every section has a table, diagram, steps block or check. Section 2-3 is dense (lead, definitions, 6 steps, diagram, a long model plan in s2-b3.expect, quiz), but it is the worked example.

s3-steps is a 6-step worked example with subgoal titles. Each step gives its reason (「目的の1文は、あとの手順の物差しになります」, 「決めないと、AIが推測で項目を選びます」), and the result is a full model plan in s2-b3.expect. There is no faded step in this lesson; fading happens in vibe-ch2-practice.

Every segment has an inline check in a new context (散歩, 送迎当番, 読書記録), and every wrong option has feedback. However, the exam item q8 gives its key away: the stem says 「画面の流れと扱うデータの欄だけが空です」 and only option d repeats those words (「画面の流れと扱うデータを、自分で決めて書き足す」).

All four misconceptions from the brief are corrected in the body: s1-b5 (丸投げ), s3-b1 (「最初から完璧でなくてかまいません」), s5-b1 (全部入れる) and s2-defs/s2-table (目的と機能). Wrong options carry real beliefs and get feedback of at most 2 sentences that names the belief, e.g. q10 b 「消すと、次の版の候補も失われます」 and q6 b on leading questions.

s2-b4 is a 3-node process diagram whose labels match the text (今月の残り画面, 食費の入力画面). Its caption states the takeaway (「Mustだけなら、最初の版の画面は2つで足りる」), it has alt text and a description, and the lesson has no decorative images.

s1-b5 asks the learner to try s1-b4 with their own idea and compare the result with 「期待される結果」. s2-b3 gives a full model plan. The hint-ladder practice was split into vibe-ch2-practice, so this lesson meets only the anchor-3 level (a hands-on task with the expected result).
summary-points has 4 takeaways and comes after the exam. summary-next has a reflection prompt (「Won'tに入れる機能は何でしょう？　理由も1つ」) and a next step. The lesson has 6 flashcards and askTutor suggestions.

Claims about intent and the wrong problem cite cc-best-practices (s1-b5, s1-b4, q4). The MVP definition follows Ries and MoSCoW follows ABC (s5-defs, s5-b2). s5-b3 frames 「最初の版をMustだけで」 as this lesson's rule, not the ABC rule. I found no factual errors, and no tool versions are needed because the prompts use target any.
The text is warm です・ます with no banned phrases (lint clean). Terms are consistent (通知, 1枚企画書, 「やらないこと」 quoted as a heading). The ja-editor owns finer wording.
jp and en are present everywhere (lint locale-plain-string clean), including the diagram code, caption and alt of s2-b4 and the prompt variable hints. No text is baked into images.

mustFix.issue: q8 (o4, evaluate) gives its answer away. The stem names the empty fields (「画面の流れと扱うデータの欄だけが空です」), and only the key d repeats them (「画面の流れと扱うデータを、自分で決めて書き足す」). Options a and c do not even address the blanks, so a test-wise learner can pick d by word matching without judging what to fix or how.
mustFix.fix: Make every option act on the two empty fields, so the judgment is about how to fill them. Keep the ids and key d. JP: a 「画面の流れとデータの欄に、使う言語やファイルの分け方まで書く」; b 「画面の流れとデータの欄は、AIが補うので空のまま渡す」; c 「画面の流れとデータの欄に、思いつく例外や条件をすべて書く」; d 「画面名と保存する項目名だけを、自分で決めて書き足す」. EN: a "Fill the screen-flow and data fields down to the language and how files are split"; b "Leave the screen-flow and data fields blank, since the AI fills them in"; c "Fill the screen-flow and data fields with every edge case and condition"; d "Decide just the screen names and field names yourself, and add them". Keep the existing feedback for a, b and c. Append to the explanation 「名前だけで十分です。」 / "Names alone are enough."

niceToHave: s3-check q4 explanation: neither ch0 nor ch1 introduces Claude Code, and round 4 had already replaced this attribution with a neutral one. Replace 「Claude Codeの公式ガイド（Anthropic）も、役に立つ仕様書の特徴に、範囲外を書くことを挙げています。仕様書は、企画書のような文書です。」 with 「AIツールの開発元Anthropicのガイドも、範囲外を書くことを、役に立つ仕様書の特徴に挙げています。仕様書は、企画書のような文書です。」 (keep cite cc-best-practices).

s2-why: asking 「なぜ？」 only once yields intermediate reasons (s2-table rows 2–3: 「入力を忘れて記録が抜けるのを防げる」) that do not fit the 「誰が・どんな場面で・どうなれる」 form defined in s2-defs. Replace with 「ほしい[[機能]]が浮かんだら、「なぜそれがほしいの？」と自分に聞き返します。答えがまだ手段なら、もう1回聞きます。」
s2-check q2 option a feedback ends 「見られると何がうれしいのかを聞くと、目的が見えてきます。」, which is almost the key to exam q6 c (「カレンダーで見られると、何がうれしいの？」). Consider 「見られた結果、保護者がどうなれるかを考えると、目的が見えてきます。」

summary-next points to 「自分のアイデアで1枚企画書をつくる」 (drafts/vibe-ch2-practice.lesson.json), which course.json does not list yet. Publish both lessons together, as the brief's owner decision says, or learners get a dangling next step.
worked: to reach 4, the practice lesson's first task could be a faded version of s3-steps (the budget-app steps with the expects of ex-moscow and ex-data left blank) before the open club-app task.
summary: The lesson is tightly aligned: four objectives, each assessed inline and in the exam with transfer items. A 6-step worked example gives the reason for every step, and distractors carry real misconceptions. The one blocker is exam item q8, where the key repeats the stem's 「画面の流れと扱うデータ」 and two distractors ignore the blanks. Rewrite its options so all four act on the empty fields.
